quests.title: A Day Like Any Other
quests.summary: Serene has asked me to check on Halden, Elira, and the Venn family. Tomas is coming along to Halden's place first.
quests.accept_text: Medicine and household supplies added to your satchel. I: inventory.
quests.parallel_tracker_text: Visit Elira and the Venn family.
quests.completion_text: Serene's three households have been helped.
quests.implementation_note: All three households, the report, Halden’s arrival and the Mira handoff are playable. MQ01 completes after the mill exchange.

objectives.text: Bring Halden his medicine, move three grain sacks with Tomas, then see Tomas back to his preparations.
objectives.tracker_text: Visit Halden with Tomas.
objectives.completion_text: Halden has his medicine. Tomas has returned to his preparations.

objectives.text: Deliver Elira's food and lamp oil, and retrieve her memorial lantern from the high shelf.
objectives.tracker_text: Visit Elira.
objectives.completion_text: Elira has her supplies and her memorial lantern.

objectives.text: Bring recovery supplies to the Venn family and repair their irrigation gate.
objectives.tracker_text: Visit the Venn family.
objectives.completion_text: The Venn family has its supplies and the irrigation channel is working again.

quests.title: A Little Trouble at the Mill
quests.summary: Help Mira investigate Halden's stopped mill, face the danger on the river path together, and restore the upstream intake.

objectives.text: Ask Mira to help with the stopped mill.
objectives.tracker_text: Find Mira at her workbench.

objectives.text: Inspect the mill mechanism and its water supply with Mira.
objectives.tracker_text: Inspect the mechanism and millrace.

objectives.text: Hear Mira’s warning and prepare to leave the village together.
objectives.tracker_text: Speak with Mira before taking the north road.

objectives.text: Face the riverbank monster with Mira and make the intake trail safe.
objectives.tracker_text: Follow the north trail with Mira. Stay together by the riverbank.

objectives.text: Follow the millrace upstream and examine the intake.
objectives.tracker_text: Follow the trail upstream with Mira.

objectives.text: Help Mira relieve the intake pressure.
objectives.tracker_text: Secure the intake bypass.

objectives.text: Clear the trapped still water from the inspection recess.
objectives.tracker_text: Use a small spell to clear the inspection recess.

objectives.text: Help Mira free the intake screen and shift the fallen limb.
objectives.tracker_text: Work with Mira to restore the intake.

objectives.text: Return and verify that the mill wheel is turning.
objectives.tracker_text: Return to the mill and check the wheel.

objectives.text: Finish the exchange with Mira and Halden.
objectives.tracker_text: Speak with Mira and Halden at the mill.

quests.accept_text: Mira is coming with you. Inspect the stopped mill together.
quests.report_text: Speak with Mira and Halden at the working mill.
quests.completion_text: Halden's mill is running again. You and Mira restored its intake together.

quests.title: The Regent's Road
quests.summary: Help Serene welcome Regent Aldric to Eldenmere. Meet his party by the brook and accompany them to the sanctuary.
quests.available_tracker_text: Speak with Mother Serene in the sanctuary dining room about the visiting regent.
quests.accept_text: Meet Aldric’s party by the brook.
quests.report_text: Speak with Mother Serene after the visit.
quests.completion_text: Aldric's visit has ended. Festival preparations continue.

objectives.text: Meet Aldric's party by the brook.
objectives.tracker_text: Meet the visitors by the brook.

objectives.text: Accompany Aldric through the village and into the sanctuary dining room.
objectives.tracker_text: Bring Aldric inside to the sanctuary dining room.

objectives.text: Help welcome the visitors and hear Aldric and Serene's conversation.
objectives.tracker_text: Join the visitors in the sanctuary dining room.

objectives.text: Speak with Serene after her conversation with Aldric.
objectives.tracker_text: Speak with Mother Serene after the visit.

quests.title: A Light of His Own
quests.summary: Help Liam make his first lantern of his own and discover what the Festival of Light means to his neighbours.
quests.available_tracker_text: Speak with Tomas in the sanctuary dining room.
quests.accept_text: Join the school’s festival preparations with Tomas.
quests.report_text: Show Mother the lantern, then put it away safely at home.
quests.completion_text: Liam is ready to carry his own lantern at the festival.
quests.implementation_note: The full four-part quest is playable: school and workshop, village visits, home break and sanctuary conversation, personal purpose and covering, a school visit to Mother, and safe storage at home. MQ04 completes at done with all eight objectives. The unlit lantern persists; the festival starts in a later quest.

objectives.text: Join the school preparation session and agree on Liam’s outing.
objectives.tracker_text: Join the lantern preparations at the village school.

objectives.text: Help Liam and Mira construct his tower-shaped lantern frame.
objectives.tracker_text: Help Liam build his lantern frame with Mira.

objectives.text: See how the village is preparing its festival contributions.
objectives.tracker_text: Visit the village preparations with Liam.

objectives.text: Spend time with Elira and her memorial lantern.
objectives.tracker_text: Visit Elira with Liam.

objectives.text: Take a break from the preparations with Liam and Tomas.
objectives.tracker_text: Take a break with Liam and Tomas.

objectives.text: Bring Liam’s questions to Mother Serene.
objectives.tracker_text: Speak with Mother Serene.

objectives.text: Help Liam choose his lantern’s purpose and finish it.
objectives.tracker_text: Finish Liam’s lantern together.

objectives.text: Let Liam show his mother what he made, then put the lantern away safely at home.
objectives.tracker_text: Show Mother the lantern and return it safely home.
